summary: Frontend-only testing of the new 'Quotes' sidebar accordion and Contract Documents access. All 4 requested checks passed: (1) Quotes accordion expands to 3 sub-links with the expected data-testids; (2) Contract Documents route loads AdminContractsPage listing the 3 seeded templates (MSA-Default, Mutual NDA, SOW-Required); (3) full CRUD (create TEST_Contract_E2E then delete) worked end-to-end against /api/contract-templates; (4) Quote Builder, Contract Documents, and Quote Settings each navigate to correct URLs and only the active sub-link gets the highlighted class (bg-blue-600 text-white). No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Two 404 console errors observed on the Contract Documents page (unrelated resources, not the templates API which succeeded). Non-blocking, but worth investigating to keep console clean.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_Contract_E2E contract template as part of CRUD verification. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar link testids follow admin-sidebar-link-<path-with-dashes>. Quotes children: admin-sidebar-link-admin-quotes-contracts-esign (Quote Builder), admin-sidebar-link-admin-quotes-contracts-esign-contracts (Contract Documents), admin-sidebar-link-admin-quotes-settings (Quote Settings). The Contract Documents new-doc modal has an input with placeholder containing 'Standard Service Agreement' for Document Name and a contenteditable for content. Save button text: 'Save Document'. The infinite-spinner harness issue mentioned by the main agent did NOT occur here.
